visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Name the Pegs by Their Role
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The pegs are called a, b and c, and the base case is written for n == 1. Rename them from, via and to, and use the simpler base case n == 0. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Descriptive parameter names make the three roles obvious, and a base case of zero disks removes the duplicated print statement.
